notes: PR #635: SA103F bridging on HMRC STANDARD tax periods. Chris elected standard quarters (6th-5th), so Q1 2026/27 is 6 Apr - 5 Jul 2026 — a date range ProfitLossReportService could not express (month bounds only). Added optional startDate/endDateExclusive exact bounds; month buckets still span the partial first/last month, so on a partial period read `total`, NEVER the month cells. Bounds are validated (shape, real calendar date, start<end) and THROW — a malformed bound previously yielded a silently empty report on the path that generates tax figures. Committed scripts/mtd-sa103-boxes.ts (owns the P&L-row -> SA103F-box map, THROWS on any unmapped expense row) and rebuilt scripts/make-mtd-sa103.py (the original was a throwaway and was lost; patches raw sheet XML, values in column C never the narrow column-B '£' labels, verifies every cell by re-reading the saved workbook). The fail-loud guard earned its keep twice: caught eBay Insertion Fees (£10.92, absent from Apr-Jun, present 1-5 Jul) on first run, and code review caught eBay Ad Fees - Advanced as the only expense row with no box.
